look_here_first: Think tall wetland obedient-plant: a rhizomatous perennial often over 1 m tall, with opposite narrow leaves and a long spike of pink-purple bilabiate flowers in saturated stream-edge or drainage habitat.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: elongated terminal spike of pink-purple bilabiate flowers

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flowers borne in repeated verticillaster-like clusters

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: streambank, ditch, spring, river-edge and saturated sediment habitat

lookalikes.differences: Compared with the broad Physostegia virginiana complex, P. correllii is a rare southern wetland specialist with strong stream-edge affiliation and a tall, rhizomatous habit.
